steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each reading is placed against its permit limit.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 reading is above its permit limit

findings.title: Reading above its permit limit
findings.fix: Report the exceedance and act on the source

findings.title: Parameter with no limit in the permit
findings.fix: Check the permit for the limit

outcome.notChecked: Whether the monitoring equipment was calibrated; the permit's legal effect.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] reading-water.csv:12  Reading above its permit limit.
       Fix: Report the exceedance and act on the source.
[medium] permit-limits.md:19  Parameter with no limit in the permit.
       Fix: Check the permit for the limit.
[low] sampling.csv:26  Missing sampling date.
       Fix: Record the sampling date.
Not checked: Whether the monitoring equipment was calibrated; the permit's legal effect.
pros: Checks a reading above its limit, a parameter with no limit in the permit, a reading with no unit, and a missing sampling date.
cons: Not checked: Whether the monitoring equipment was calibrated; the permit's legal effect.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-ehs-environmental-monitoring skill on the records for this review.
